tool_args.rationale: The 7 paid rows provide broad input variation and a substantial sink-gradient contrast, enough to fit the three parameters of the simpler positive-branch inland-hub siphon. The previous barrier-activated model failed confirmation, so this step tests the simpler stationary saturation-plus-sink-inhibition form without buying a costly trajectory batch.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It targets multi-state ODE identification; observed rows are same-horizon static-response data and support direct gradient-response fitting.
Its previous fresh-confirmation RMSE was 0.547389, far above tolerance, refuting this specific barrier activation form.
There is no reported chaotic sign oscillation; the failure is consistent with a wrong stationary mechanism rather than evidence all smooth mechanisms fail.
